findings.statement: The Edge's analysis of Binance's 1 October 2026 PoR page reports XRP reserve coverage of 100.77% and customer net balances of 2.496B XRP, rounded to the nearest million; Gate News reports the same 100.77% ratio. Binance's official PoR page describes wallet ownership verification, user-balance snapshots and a Download All Address control, but the actual file was not retrieved.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The reserve baseline is pre-incident and secondary-reported; no official XRP address export or exact five-wallet crosswalk is available.

findings.statement: Using the rounded reported baseline, implied pre-incident XRP reserves are approximately 2.5152B and surplus approximately 19.2192M XRP. If all 233.4619431M XRP transferred from the five incident source wallets came from PoR-listed reserves with no offsets, modeled coverage would be approximately 91.42% and shortfall approximately 214.243M XRP. About 8.23% of the incident transfer from PoR-listed reserves would exhaust the implied surplus.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: This is not an observed post-incident reserve ratio. The five XRPL source wallets' membership in the official PoR address set is unknown, and Binance subsequently reported company funds, frozen assets and replenishment activity.

market_observations.notes: The Edge says customer balances are rounded to the nearest million and ratio is on-chain wallet balance divided by customer net account balance. Gate News corroborates 100.77%; both report the same Binance snapshot, not independent address-level recalculations.

Assumes the fraction of the 233.4619431M transfer sourced from PoR-listed wallets is 100% for the full-loss scenario. At approximately 8.23% of the transfer, the reported 0.77% reserve cushion is exhausted. Official address membership and offsets are unknown.

competing_hypotheses.claim: If more than approximately 8.23% of the 233.4619431 XRP incident transfer originated from wallets included in Binance's 1 October 2026 XRP PoR address set, the reported 0.77% pre-incident XRP reserve cushion would be exhausted absent offsetting reserve balances or replenishment. If all of it came from PoR-listed wallets, the conditional ratio would be about 91.42%.
supporting_evidence: The Edge reports 100.77% XRP PoR coverage and 2.496B XRP customer net balances on 1 October 2026.
The five validated XRPL incident payments total 233,461,943.1 XRP.
The implied pre-incident surplus from rounded figures is approximately 19.219M XRP, 8.23% of the incident transfer.
disconfirming_evidence: No official October 1 PoR XRP address export has been retrieved or matched to the five source wallets.
The 100.77% ratio and 2.496B customer balance are secondary-reported and rounded.
Binance later reported more than $6.34B in company funds, approximately $3B frozen and market/OTC replenishment; these offsets are not included in the stress arithmetic.
unknowns: Which of the five XRPL source wallets, if any, are included in the official XRP PoR address set.
Exact October 1 reserve-address XRP total and exact customer net liabilities.
Post-incident XRP reserve-address balances and token-specific replenishment.

next_actions: Retrieve Binance's official October 1 PoR address export and crosswalk all five XRPL source wallets.
Obtain exact source-address XRP balances and customer net-liability figure from the official snapshot.
Compare the November 1 PoR XRP reserve ratio and address balances after incident remediation.
Keep the 91.42% result scenario-only until address membership and offsets are verified.
